Name: Hanani, the Seer
Summary: Hanani the seer rebuked Asa for relying on the king of Syria instead of the LORD, and Asa in rage put him in a prison house.
KeyStory: Hanani reminded Asa that the LORD had delivered the huge Ethiopian and Lubim host, and warned that from henceforth Asa would have wars.
RelatedPeople: King Asa; Jehu, Son of Hanani
LifeLesson: A true seer speaks even when the king would rather hear something else.
